verification_questions.question: Does GET /api/search accept query, wing, room, max_distance, limit and return results?
verification_questions.expected: Yes, test_search_returns_results, test_search_with_limit, test_search_with_wing_filter verify this

verification_questions.question: Does GET /api/status return total_drawers, wings, rooms?
verification_questions.expected: Yes, test_status_returns_palace_info verifies all fields; test_status_empty_palace verifies graceful handling of empty palace

verification_questions.question: Does GET /api/taxonomy return nested {wing: {room: count}} structure?
verification_questions.expected: Yes, test_taxonomy_returns_hierarchy verifies Web/Captures, Web/Articles, Research/Papers

verification_questions.question: Does GET /api/rooms accept optional wing param and return room counts?
verification_questions.expected: Yes, test_rooms_returns_all_rooms and test_rooms_filters_by_wing verify both cases

verification_questions.question: Does GET /api/drawers/by-url return exists/drawer_id/title when found, and {exists: false} when not?
verification_questions.expected: Yes, test_by_url_found and test_by_url_not_found verify both cases; queries ChromaDB metadata directly
